clusters.title: MiniCPM-V crashes at server warmup: `'MiniCPMV2_6' object has no attribute 'shared_experts_config'` — 3 legs, every lane

cause_prs.author: ch-wan
cause_prs.title: [Refactor] moe: Scope shared-expert configuration to each model

fix_prs.author: losewayy
fix_prs.title: [Fix] minicpmv: Preserve chaining on delegated methods

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
First failure is N20. The test passed in all 14 earlier runs; the last pass was N19 at [`5ed306bd`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/5ed306bd69be18ce97f8e9d57721da7e05bd2f9f).
The crash also stopped the subtest loop, so 6 later VLMs went unevaluated on every lane.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]`: [`6b90e571`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/6b90e5716d4246d2a772bef06c7ddecceb6ac6ed) ([#44913](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44913), merged Oct 19 23:59) added an unconditional read of `model_runner.model.shared_experts_config` (`base_runner.py:250`). The loader sets that attribute on the `MiniCPMV` wrapper, but its `model.eval()` returns the inner module, which never gets it.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: not reproduced locally, and NVIDIA nightly was not checked.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ⚠️ [#41391](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41391) (open since Sep 27, `blocked`) makes delegated methods return the wrapper. It was written for another symptom and is not verified against this crash. [#45419](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45419) covers MLX only.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: apply #41391 on [`c2e57424`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/c2e574246485a055c0e51d60d1eae027e5d629c0) and launch `openbmb/MiniCPM-v-2_6` on MI300. Also check other `__getattr__` wrapper models, such as `Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration`.

clusters.title: Qwen3.5 Triton DCP (TP4/DCP4) server hang on the first GSM8K batch — 2 legs, intermittent

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
rocm720 has hung the same way 5 times since Oct 5 (Oct 5, 8, 9, 13, 19).
rocm10 hung for the first time in N20, while rocm720 passed on the same commit (0.957).
In all 5 runs whose first eval prefill was `843 tok, queue 11`, the server hung.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[LOW]`: ranks disagree on prefix KV. TP0 enters the DCP collectives (`triton_backend.py:2092/2130`) while TP1–3 return early at `:2085`.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: no direct evidence of rank-divergent `extend_prefix_lens`. The Oct 8 hang started from a different first request.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. **Suggested triage**: log `extend_prefix_lens` and `kv_indices.numel()` per rank in `_forward_extend_dcp`, then replay the 843-token-first request order on MI35x.

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
None of the three files appears in any of the 11 H/I/J shard logs I checked. In each of those runs, R220's collection error aborted one shard per lane.
[#44599](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44599) (merged Oct 20 06:24) removed that error.

details.label: R271
details.text: `[LOW]`: the customized text-encoder load reaches `get_world_group()` (`parallel_state.py:79`) before the test's `fallback` sentinel, and fails on all 3 lanes. The file has not changed since Oct 8.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: K predates #44599 and already ran this file, so the "newly exposed" explanation is incomplete.

details.label: R272
details.text: `[LOW]`: `test_native_hybrid_encoder_matches_hf[*-left/right-17]` shows 54–63% mismatched elements on rocm720/724 only. The same cases pass on rocm10 ([L (0)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39421857090/job/118624622617)).

details.label: R273
details.text: `[MEDIUM]`: `mxfp8_online.py:17` imports `ScalingType` from `torch.nn.functional`. That name is missing from the rocm720 lane's torch 2.9.1 / Python 3.10, and the same tests pass on rocm10.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none for any of the three. I searched `test_text_encoder_loader`, `world group is not initialized`, `qwen3_5_encoder`, `ScalingType` and `mxfp8_online`.
R273: guard the import, or skip the file when the torch version is too old.
R272: compare the HF reference against the native encoder in the rocm724 image.
R271: run the test on NVIDIA to see whether it is ROCm-specific.
